title: Social media
slide_intent: Distinguish the identity of an individual post from the identity of the account hosting it. Readers can encounter either at a small size.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can vary campaign art across posts while a repeated symbol and cover treatment identify its account.
demonstration: Several overlapping social post cards occupy the left. On the right, an enlarged device view pairs a symbol avatar with a pink cover showing a megaphone.
practical_value: Test a message inside a realistic post frame, then compare the account cover and avatar at their separate scales.

content_islands.name: Post examples
content_islands.spec: On a green field, overlap the small platform cards while leaving the campaign imagery and key type legible.

content_islands.name: Profile view
content_islands.spec: Give the device at right more space; show the compact avatar independently of the wider cover graphic and the feed beneath.
